pre: unshare -n sleep 60 >/dev/null 2>&1 & p=$!; for i in $(seq 50); do [ "$(readlink /proc/$p/ns/net)" != "$(readlink /proc/self/ns/net)" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done; ip link add v0 address 02:00:00:00:00:01 type veth peer name v1 address 02:00:00:00:00:02 netns "$p" && ip link set v0 up && nsenter -t "$p" -n sh -c 'ip link set v1 up && tipc node set identity 1002 && tipc bearer enable media eth device v1'
tipc bearer enable media eth device v0
for i in $(seq 100); do tipc link list | grep -qx '1001:v0-1002:v1: up' && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; exit 1
